purpose: Break the source-acquisition deadlock by running the already-frozen primary Jain developability analysis on a pinned public transcription while preserving the canonical publisher-artifact run as blocked.
claim_boundary: A mirror replication may expose whether the frozen selection result is likely worth pursuing. It cannot upgrade CPG-001 to a canonical confirmatory result and cannot establish publisher-byte provenance.

source.reported_origin: Jain et al. 2017 PNAS supplementary biophysical dataset

status_labels.effect: approved-2017 descriptive metrics remain null; the preregistered primary verdict uses assay measurements only

success_semantics: Workflow success means the pinned mirror was byte-bound by Git blob identity, parsed as 137 candidates, and the frozen analysis completed. A negative scientific verdict is still a successful execution.
next_use: If this replication is negative, stop spending effort on canonical acquisition for CPG-001. If it is positive, obtain the exact publisher artifacts once through a human-browser or archival deposit and use them only to confirm the already-observed result.
